title: Mountjoy square
html_source:
The park across from the Catholic presbytery where Father Conmee’s journey begins. I have added a link to a blog in which I have embedded a Google Earth tour of the places Father Conmee visits on this trek. A downloaded version of the Google Earth program will allow one to view it.

http://3d3o.blogspot.com/
